inputs.label: Average earnings (level)
inputs.help: Average earnings per employee.

inputs.label: Employment (level)
inputs.help: Number of people in work. Feeds income tax and NICs, and working-age benefits via the change in millions.

inputs.label: Unemployment
inputs.help: ILO unemployment, in millions of people. Feeds universal credit.

inputs.label: Self-employment income
inputs.help: Mixed income: profits of the self-employed. Self-assessment tax is paid a year later.

inputs.label: Earnings growth in Q2
inputs.help: Year-on-year earnings growth in April to June: the earnings leg of the pensions triple lock.

inputs.label: Earnings growth in Q3
inputs.help: Year-on-year earnings growth in July to September: used to uprate some benefits.

inputs.label: Consumer spending (cash)
inputs.help: Nominal household consumption: the VAT base.

inputs.label: Consumer spending (volume)
inputs.help: Real household consumption: drives alcohol and fuel duty volumes.

inputs.label: Spending on durable goods
inputs.help: Nominal consumption of durables (cars, furniture...).

inputs.label: Real GDP
inputs.help: Used for fuel duty and air passenger duty volumes.

inputs.label: Nominal GDP (financial year)
inputs.help: Cash GDP: other receipts, some spending lines, and the denominator for '% of GDP'.

inputs.label: Nominal GDP (calendar year)
inputs.help: Used for VAT.

inputs.label: Nominal GDP (centred on March)
inputs.help: The denominator for debt as a % of GDP.

inputs.label: Imports
inputs.help: Customs duties base.

inputs.label: Non-financial company profits
inputs.help: Non-oil, non-financial profits: onshore corporation tax (and SA tax on dividends a year later).

inputs.label: Financial company profits
inputs.help: Onshore corporation tax from banks and other financial firms.

inputs.label: Business investment (PNFCs)
inputs.help: Private non-financial companies' investment: capital allowances reduce corporation tax.

inputs.label: Share prices
inputs.help: FTSE All-Share level: capital gains tax (a year later), stamp duty on shares, inheritance tax.

inputs.label: House prices
inputs.help: Stamp duty land tax, inheritance tax, capital gains tax.

inputs.label: Property transactions
inputs.help: Number of property sales: stamp duty land tax.

inputs.label: Household bank deposits
inputs.help: Inheritance tax base.

inputs.label: CPI inflation
inputs.help: Financial-year CPI inflation. Raises the CPI price level, which uprates duties, business rates and some spending.

inputs.label: CPI inflation in September (Q3)
inputs.help: Q3 CPI inflation: benefits are uprated by it the following April. Change it alongside CPI inflation.

inputs.label: RPI inflation
inputs.help: Financial-year RPI inflation: index-linked gilt payments (debt interest).

inputs.label: RPI inflation in Q2
inputs.help: Q2 RPI inflation: some duties are uprated by the RPI.

inputs.label: Oil price
inputs.help: Brent, US dollars a barrel: North Sea taxes and fuel duty.

inputs.label: Gas price
inputs.help: Wholesale gas, pence a therm: North Sea taxes and the energy profits levy.

inputs.label: Wholesale electricity price
inputs.help: Electricity generator levy.

inputs.label: Dollar-sterling exchange rate
inputs.help: Dollars per pound.

inputs.label: Bank Rate
inputs.help: Interest on reserves (debt interest) and on government deposits.

inputs.label: Deposit rates
inputs.help: Rates paid to savers: tax on savings income.

inputs.label: Gilt yields
inputs.help: Market interest rates on government bonds: debt interest on new borrowing.
